newsitem.title: UK: Burford says to demerge from Grantchester.
newsitem.headline: Burford says to demerge from Grantchester.

text.p: Property company Burford Plc said on Monday it would demerge from Grantchester, which will seek a listing on the Official List of the London Stock Exchange.
Burford said Grantchester will buy a retail park in Falkirk and an option over a retail park in Huddersfield with a total value of 41.145 million stg from Burford.
Burford said following listing, Grantchester would have pro forma net assets of 63.4 million stg, equivalent to 91 pence per share.
The pro forma value of the investment properties would be 86 million stg, rising to over 100 million stg on exercise of the option on the Huddersfield property.
Grantchester would then be the UK's largest quoted property company specialising in retail warehouse schemes.
Burford said existing management of Grantchester would retain around a 30 percent stake.
Burford will keep a 24 percent stake in Grantchester.
Burford said its shareholders would receive approximately one Grantchester share for every 13 Burford shares held, giving them a 46 percent stake in Grantchester.
